title: A New Website and Dashboard
summary: The site has been rebuilt around Niko's own interface: a new landing page, one graphite, steel and sage theme carried through every public page, and a dashboard whose pickers, selectors and settings panels were rebuilt to match it.

highlights.title: The Landing Page Is the Product
highlights.description: The page now leads with the VoiceMaster panel Niko actually posts — the same buttons, the same app badge, real replies in the same card — instead of a screenshot or a painted-on dashboard mock. The member list behind it opens real profile cards.

highlights.title: One Theme, Every Page
highlights.description: Commands, documentation, changelog, team profiles and the landing page now share the graphite, steel and sage palette, the same hairline cards and the same ambient canvas, so moving between them no longer feels like visiting a different site.

highlights.title: Dashboard Controls, Rebuilt
highlights.description: Every dashboard dropdown is now the same popup of buttons: a trigger, arrow, Enter and Escape handling, a highlight that follows the pointer and a tick on the chosen row, with channel icons and role dots where they help. The list is drawn in a portal, so it can escape a settings card that blurs what is behind it.

highlights.title: Docs and Commands, One Library
highlights.description: The commands page and the documentation centre were rethemed together: one type scale, matching cards and a search bar that looks and behaves the same in both.

items: A new landing page built around the bot's own VoiceMaster panel
An ambient shader canvas behind the public pages
Shared select menu, role picker and channel select components for the dashboard
The graphite, steel and sage palette replaces the warm café styling across the site
Glass card treatment on the commands, docs, changelog and team pages
Dashboard settings, notifier and staff application views rebuilt on the new controls
One type scale shared by the commands page and the documentation centre
